text:
deploy-bot: ✅ start rollout release/2.14.0 -> prod (eu-west-1) canary=10% image=rdx-serving:2.14.0
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: synth-heartbeat (eu-west-1) failing 5/5 probes in last 2m — 503 responses
anna: saw the alert, pausing the ramp for eu. tagging @michael @tara to triage
michael: looking at logs — several model containers returning 503 during kv cache warmup, also a transient spike of oom-kill on node pool a-io-3
tara: EU synth latency is +300ms vs baseline, customers on EU reported slow responses for short chat flows. do we want to pin the model variant in eu region?
leo: pin sounds safest. we can stop the rollout in eu and pin to rdx-v2.13.3 until we confirm cache warmup fix. small blast radius.
anna: agree. plan: 1) pin eu to rdx-v2.13.3 2) abort further canary ramps in eu 3) keep us-only ramp if healthy 4) open postmortem if rollback needed
michael: executing pin now — command:```bash
redwoodctl rollout pin --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --model=rdx-v2.13.3 --reason="synth-heartbeat failures"
```
michael: result: pinned successfully, rollout halted in eu, canary remains 10% in us-west-2 only
deploy-bot: action acknowledged — pinned model rdx-v2.13.3 in prod (eu-west-1). aborting further eu ramp.
sre-oncall: created incident INC-4823 and linked dashboards https://dash.redwood/INC-4823 ; I'll watch synth-heartbeat and node pool metrics for 1h and ping if status changes
anna: thanks — I'll update release notes and notify account team for EU customers. we'll reconvene after 30m checks. :thumbsup:
